Developers who focus on both design and fundamental functionality are known as “design-focused developers.” They are also responsible for the software’s scalability and efficiency and the smooth operation of systems and servers that may be located in different geographic regions than the end users. The programmer must be proficient in numerous programming languages, such as C++, C, Ruby, Python, Perl, Go, Scala, etc. The typical income of a backend developer in India is Rs 680,680 per year. Source – Indeed 3. Full-Stack Developers Full-stack developers typically have an understanding of frontend and backend practices and philosophies. Among the primary responsibilities are the design of user interactions for servers, websites, and databases, as well as implementing mobile platforms and website functionality. It takes a full-stack developer to complete a project from inception to completion. They necessitate solid organisational abilities and meticulousness. They are responsible for developing and organising front-end web architecture, ensuring apps are responsive, and working with visual designers to develop web design components. Your pay as a senior ReactJS developer in India can reach about INR 1,700,000 per year as your knowledge and expertise grow.
